## What an agent cannot currently answer

Describe the question your agent could not answer, or the wrong answer it gave
because this does not exist.

## Which phase does this belong to

Check [docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md) first — it may already be planned
and published in `genxevo_agent_status`. If so, say so and describe what would
change about the plan.

## What evidence would the capability return

This product returns observations with signals and confidence, not conclusions.
What would it have actually looked at?

## What would it refuse

A capability with no refusals is usually a capability with a hole in it.
